name: Figma Trigger (Beta)
category_description: Trigger node - starts a workflow when an event happens
description: Figma is a prototyping tool which is primarily web-based, with more offline features enabled by desktop applications for macOS and Windows

events.name: File Commented
events.description: Triggers when someone comments on a file

events.name: File Deleted
events.description: Triggers when someone deletes an individual file, but not when someone deletes an entire folder with all files

events.name: File Updated
events.description: Triggers when someone saves or deletes a file. A save occurs when someone closes a file within 30 seconds after making changes

events.name: File Version Updated
events.description: Triggers when someone creates a named version in the version history of a file

events.name: Library Publish
events.description: Triggers when someone publishes a library file

subtitle: ={{$parameter["triggerOn"]}}

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Trigger will monitor this Figma Team for changes. Team ID can be found in the URL of a Figma Team page when viewed in a web browser: figma.com/files/team/{TEAM-ID}/.

options.name: File Commented
options.description: Triggers when someone comments on a file

options.name: File Deleted
options.description: Triggers whenever a file has been deleted. Does not trigger on all files within a folder, if the folder is deleted.

options.name: File Updated
options.description: Triggers whenever a file saves or is deleted. This occurs whenever a file is closed or within 30 seconds after changes have been made.

options.name: File Version Updated
options.description: Triggers whenever a named version is created in the version history of a file

options.name: Library Publish
options.description: Triggers whenever a library file is published
